requirement.value: Cunning Folk mastery + Fey Crossing (and the Rituals benefit-pool pick)

system.description: A Ritual creating a permanent fey crossing at your location: (INS + WLP), 80 MP, Difficulty 13, Major/Small, usable thereafter with Fey Crossing. Backfire: "you attract the attention of something greater than yourself." Your gates are safer than wild ones but not safe — they draw other fey. Requires the Rituals benefit-pool pick; Guises grant no ritual access. At 80 MP against a level-30 pool of roughly 90 it is very nearly everything you have, which is right for a door between worlds. Treat the Backfire as a real hook: it names no creature and no consequence, which makes a failed Fey Gate a district-level event.
